title: HOW TO CATCH AN AI LIAR: LIE DETECTION IN BLACK-BOX LLMS BY ASKING UNRELATED QUESTIONS
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting lies in LLMs, which is a core topic in ethics and moral reasoning regarding honesty and deception. It includes specific datasets and scenarios involving ethical dilemmas (e.g., in medical and sales contexts) and uses religion as one of its classification topics for testing lie detection.
